findings.message: The current monolithic train.py cannot be reused with its frozen SHA-256 while also making validation imports, val_loader construction, inline validation, final evaluate_bpb, and heldout diagnostics unreachable. Import/runpy, textual-prefix, signal, trace, monkeypatch, AST-splice, and copied-loop approaches are not source-faithful governed execution. Relevant current boundaries are validation imports 427-436, setup 3249+, val_loader 3628, training 3718-4129, inline validation 4073-4083, final validation 4260-4268, and heldout diagnostics 4276-4321.

The future registration scheduler map is required to embed the runtime-runner digest, while the runner currently embeds the registration-helper digest. Changing either digest changes the other artifact, so the planned bidirectional SHA-256 closure cannot be finalized. Authority must be acyclic: stable leaf sources to a detached source manifest to a detached execution authority.

A conforming worker requires a prospective move, not copy, of model/training code into an import-safe training-only core with explicit session and pre-optimizer hook APIs, preserved consumed-batch identity, train-shard-only capability, and a thin endpoint wrapper that imports evaluation after training. This necessarily changes train.py and setup hashes and requires paper, registry, runner, diagnostic, worker, authority, and test rebinding before any execution.

GPT.forward currently returns only loss when targets are supplied, so the frozen step-zero logits observable is not exposed. The pre-optimizer hook must occur after backward and before optimizer mutation while preserving the consumed batch before the current prefetch replaces x and y.

scope: Paper-020 GPAS no-validation worker feasibility and execution-authority hash closure
summary: Independent read-only runtime review and coordinator source verification found that Paper 020 remains non-executable for two structural reasons: no safe no-validation worker boundary exists under the frozen monolith, and the planned registration/runner digest graph is cyclic. No shortcut, proposal registration, remote mutation, GPU launch, endpoint scoring, comparator rebind, or SOTA claim is authorized. The safe route is a prospectively amended import-safe training core plus a detached one-way authority manifest.

scope: Independent adversarial rescore of eleven 2025-2026 mechanism-backed plateau proposals
summary: The independent critic reduced the future-paper shortlist to B1 document-bounded suffix keys, A1 split GPAS, and A4 learnable Peri gamma. B1 is the only independent near-term candidate and still needs a frozen premise-spec amendment. A1 and A4 are conditional on accepted Paper-020 parents. No candidate is executable or registered; B3 must be withdrawn and corrected, A3/A6/A8 are hard vetoes, and A2/A4 are mutually exclusive branches.

findings.message: Peri-LN Proposition 3.1 is in Section 3.4, not 3.3, and concerns a last-layer MLP/RMSNorm gradient rather than attention or adaptive clipping. Figures 8 and 9b distinguish frozen and learnable gamma; neither tests the proposed cap.

Conditioned Initialization construction is Appendix A.1.1, while A.2 covers normalization and partial initialization; Proposition 3.2 does not prove the true Jacobian improves. Spectral Conditioning implements fixed lambda-I at lambda=10, not a frozen semi-orthogonal base. The sources do not support the proposed anchor.

Exact cited Engram locators are from the preserved updated 33-page repository PDF, whereas the ACL camera-ready is a 23-page DSE-named version. ACL provenance must be version-qualified rather than attached to updated wording by implication.

Engram defines suffix n-grams and Tensorizing Engram states left padding at sequence start. Local prev_idx and prev2_idx row shifts can cross internal packed BOS boundaries while attention isolation does not repair memory keys. The BOS reset is a plausible local repair, but neither source establishes its proposed proxy threshold or endpoint gain.

The Best Paper source uses a full pre-normalized state, sigmoid gate in [0,1], and pre-projection SDPA-output placement. The local proposal only widens the existing zero-initialized 2-sigmoid post-head-RMS gate. Venue status does not validate this partial-width edit.
No full-text mHC primary artifact is preserved locally; the abstract supports manifold-constrained residual mixing generally, not the exact x0 writeback construction or quantitative claims.

Current document isolation is true for the accepted resolved FA3 environment. Bare source defaults are not a valid resolved execution because default SDPA conflicts with the varlen implementation requirement.

findings.message: The eight held-out deltas share six or seven fit shards and are not independent randomized units. Seven-of-eight positive may remain a deterministic robustness gate, but 9/256 cannot be reported as a valid exact p-value.
The finite-shard packer must freeze whole-batch refill overshoot, row-group tail batching, EOF drain/cropping, and one-token residual handling; capacity 1000 is ambiguous relative to live lib.py.
Exposure, update, and dispersion must use actual physical row q=h_s(K_a) with arm/site indices. Semantic keys can differ while physical hashes collide, and parity must admit that case.
The specification must state whether each of 11/14 sites passes only when exposure, update, and dispersion thresholds all pass, and whether aggregate gates are conjunctive.
Exact runtime shard IDs, loader/packer semantics, batch, sequence length, accumulation, step numbering, environment, resolved configuration, and digest serialization remain unspecified.
Cross-document fragments more predictive, affected exposure absent, and wrong sign must be deleted as redundant or assigned exact prospective statistics and thresholds.

Freeze within-placement and cross-placement geometric aggregation explicitly and define graph-count scope; one graph across model, backward, and separately compiled optimizer kernels is incompatible with current topology.
The canonical manifest and key/count/provenance/output schemas must be persisted and independently audited before data access; the proposed digest is not yet an artifact fact.

findings.message: The packed-row schema permits token_count=1 although the finite-EOF procedure drops one-token tails; the permitted range must be [2,2049], and dropped-tail summary fields and types must be exact.
The runtime state digest does not enumerate fixed dtype codes, scalar type tags, or canonical nested optimizer-state path flattening, so distinct conforming encoders remain possible.
Finite-gradient, co-tenancy, and eligible-H200 conditions remain prose rather than exact tests and thresholds; they must be operationalized or deleted before authority.
Packing summary, offline result, runtime result, and output manifest lack complete required-key, type, and cardinality schemas despite the v2 requirement for byte-identical prospective outputs.
